text:
Sasha: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 504s from hosted API between 13:04-13:15 UTC. p95 for /v1/generate jumped from 650ms -> 3.8s. tenant=evoke is hardest hit. Logs show request queue depth hitting hard limits.
Eli-support: Noted, customer ticket 9872 coming in. Any correlating deploys?
Frank-eng: No deploys in window. Metric snapshot:
```
queue.depth.total=1000/1000
continuous_batcher.backlog=42
inflight.requests=512
gateway.5xx.rate=23/min
```
Amber-oncall: Alerting ops. Running quick repro curl to capture headers.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3419876543. Pager notified.
Sasha: Repro curl for support:
```
curl -s -D - -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compact-1","input":"short prompt"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Mike-prod-sre: From infra dashboard the queue watermark policy triggered 'reject' at qdepth=1000. We have a cold KV cache for tenant=evoke -> increased latency, continuous-batcher accumulating prefixes.
Frank-eng: Looks like continuous-batcher target batch_size=64 vs actual 180 filling queue. Suggest temporary mitigation: lower batch target to 32 and enable prefork flush. Also increase queue depth to 1500 as short-term.
Eli-support: Customer workaround: set "prefer_low_latency":true in their SDK to route to thinpool. Sending instructions.
Amber-oncall: I'm going to restart batcher pods on pool-7 to drop backlog. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/continuous-batcher -n hosted-pool-7`
Sasha: Before restart, let's try kill -SIGINT on one worker to see graceful drain.
Frank-eng: Added a canary config patch:
```
PATCH /config/deployments/continuous-batcher
{ "batch_target": 32, "max_queue_depth": 1500 }
```
ops-bot: Config patch applied to pool-7: roll started.
Mike-prod-sre: After patch qdepth dropped to 420, p95 down to 710ms, 5xx rate falling. Customer reports reduced errors.
Eli-support: Customer notified, asking for post-mortem and permanent mitigation.
Amber-oncall: Filing follow-up runbook items: add autoscale threshold at queue_depth=700 and KV warmup for high-traffic tenants. Assigning to Frank.
Frank-eng: Will follow up with a deeper root cause (KV spin-up + batcher target mismatch). Recording repro steps and logs in the incident doc.
Sasha: Good. Keep this thread for timeline. If errors resurge ping @amber-oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
